detailed_description: Generate State embeddings for single-cell RNA-seq data using the SE-600M model. This function downloads the SE-600M model from Hugging Face, installs required dependencies (git-lfs, uv, arc-state), and generates embeddings for the input AnnData object. The SE-600M model is a state-of-the-art embedding model for single-cell data that can capture complex biological patterns and cell states. Features include real-time streaming output, automatic retry with reduced batch size on failure, GPU detection and warnings, and input validation.
when_to_use: When you need generate embeddings with state analysis

parameters.adata_filename: [Required] Name of the input AnnData file (.h5ad format) (str)
parameters.data_dir: [Required] Directory containing the input data file (str)
parameters.model_folder: [Required] Directory where the SE-600M model will be downloaded and stored (str)
parameters.output_filename: [Optional] Name of the output embeddings file. If None, will use input filename with '_state_embeddings' suffix
parameters.checkpoint: [Optional] Path to the specific model checkpoint. If None, uses the latest checkpoint in model_folder
parameters.embed_key: [Optional] Name of key to store embeddings in the output AnnData object (default: X_state)
parameters.protein_embeddings: [Optional] Path to protein embeddings override (.pt). If omitted, auto-detects in model folder
parameters.batch_size: [Optional] Batch size for embedding forward pass. Increase to use more VRAM and speed up embedding (default: 500)
